coverage.title: What is recorded?
coverage.text: Integrated user, role permission, menu, department, notification, schedule, authentication and impersonation operations, plus background task execution. Not every browsing action is recorded.

delay.title: Why might a recent operation be missing?
delay.text: Ordinary operations are saved in batches, triggered every 5 seconds or at 50 records by default. Timing depends on configuration and runtime conditions. Some critical operations are saved in the business transaction.

results.title: What do the outcomes mean?
results.text: Failure means the record reports a failure. Partial success requires checking each target. Unconfirmed means the record cannot establish the business outcome. Check details to verify the actual impact.

risk.title: Does high risk mean an incident?
risk.text: Risk describes the potential impact of an action, such as granting permissions or impersonation. It is independent of the outcome and does not establish an incident.

absence.title: Does no record mean nothing happened?
absence.text: No. Check the time range, filters and coverage, and ask an administrator to confirm delivery health. The in-memory batch queue for ordinary operations cannot guarantee immediate or lossless storage.

privacy.title: Are passwords visible?
privacy.text: Sensitive changes show only that a value changed. Request summaries are limited to allowed fields, redacted and size-limited.
